purpose: A compact pill-shaped segmented control that lets the user pick the app color-theme mode — `system`, `dark`, or `light` — via three icon-only segments. It reflects and emits the selected mode through `v-model` and applies no global side effect itself (the app decides what each mode means). Unlike `switch` (a boolean toggle) or `tabs` (view navigation), it is a fixed three-way single-select over the theme modes.
useWhen: The app-wide color mode picker in a header, footer, account menu or settings page.
avoidWhen: Picking one of other mutually exclusive options → use `toggle-group`.
Moving between views or panels → use `tabs`.
related: toggle-group` — the generic mutually exclusive option group, with labels and sizes.
switch` — boolean toggle for a single setting.
bestPractices: Bind with `v-model` and apply the mode in the app (for example a `data-theme` attribute, resolving `system` from `prefers-color-scheme`); the component has no side effects.
Persist the chosen mode on the app side so it survives a reload.
Localize `ariaLabel`; the segment names (System, Dark, Light) are fixed in the component.
